findings.summary: The generic Policy and FrontDoor can be instantiated with vacuous predicates and are not constrained to the frozen launcher contract, limits, hashes, exclusions, or training policy.
Dry-run and official authorization records, nonce consumption, reviewer independence, and phase ordering are not represented by the current Lean state machine.
The contract calls the watchdog external while placing watchdog and monitor in the monitor cgroup, so monitor OOM or a blocking fsync lacks an independently surviving hard-deadline enforcer.
Opaque quiescenceOK is not constructively tied to three empty stage cgroups, exactly four workers, frozen file descriptors, or residual-process transitions.
The Lean transition graph lacks renamedCandidate and postchecked states, detached authority-marker creation, and a proof that failed postchecks remove the authoritative-looking path.

Generic Bytes permits vacuous instances and does not bind normalized paths, complete content and metadata trees, modes, ownership, link restrictions, fsync state, or domain-separated fixed-size digests.
Tool, source, schema, test, shared-library, and authorization closures are not first-class certificates in the current formal model.
Isolation and resource predicates do not expose the frozen cgroup, cpuset, namespace, writable-mount, watchdog-survival, accounting-boundary, and verifier-agreement fields for independent projection.

required_next_version: three-role bootstrap watchdog, monitor, and sandbox model with an independently surviving hard deadline
